title: Astrolabe Roadmap Pillar
description: One pillar of the Astrolabe capability registry. Each YAML file under roadmap/ holds one pillar.

prefix.description: Three capital letters that begin the id of every capability in this pillar.

title.description: Declarative Title Case name for the pillar.

order.description: Display order of the pillar, starting at 1.

summary.description: One or two sentences on what the pillar covers.

id.description: Pillar prefix, hyphen, and two or three digits. Once published, an id never changes.

external_source.description: An existing source repository whose capability is cataloged for migration, reuse, or retirement.

source.description: Repository or codebase that owns the capability.

verdict.description: Disposition for an existing external capability: port into Astrolabe, reuse as a crate, or retire.

title.description: Declarative Title Case noun phrase without a colon.

status.description: shipped: on Astrolabe main. built: implemented in the current Astrolabe foundation wave. existing: implemented in a source repository awaiting port, reuse, or retirement. planned: scheduled for Astrolabe. idea: undecided future item. decision: open question that blocks dependent capabilities.

scope.description: Centrality to Astrolabe: core, supporting, or peripheral.

summary.description: One clear ASD-STE100 sentence on what the capability does.

depends_on.description: Capability ids that this entry directly requires.

source_ref.description: Optional repository-relative crate, directory, or file path inside the source repository.

sprint.description: Optional sprint number or point sprint string.

docs.description: Optional docs page path from repository root with optional anchor.

in_progress.description: For built work only: true while work on the capability is still unfinished.

design.description: Optional design page path from repository root with optional anchor.

draft.description: True when dependencies are a first draft that still needs review.
